confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on cost-of-living aggregators and are moderately reliable. Beer and cocktail anchors are blended from a few sources with conflicting bar figures. The wine anchor is inferred from the local beer and cocktail relationship, since no wine price data was found. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates, not checked against live listings. Yuan figures were converted at roughly 7.1 CNY per USD, an assumption. The FX value was taken from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rate page, which I did not open directly, and the 16 October figure is only published after 5pm Sydney time.
comparable_city_reasoning: Shenzhen is a large, prosperous Chinese tech hub, so it is priced like other Chinese Tier-1 cities. Food anchors are based on aggregated cost-of-living figures for Shenzhen, and drink anchors on Shenzhen bar and pub averages. The wine anchor is inferred from beer and cocktail prices. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for mid-range Shenzhen stock.
